# miniz

Vendored from https://github.com/richgel999/miniz (MIT/public domain).
Used only for strict ZIP inspection/extraction of official cache packages.

Files:
- miniz.c / miniz.h
- miniz_common.h
- miniz_zip.c / miniz_zip.h
- miniz_tdef.c / miniz_tdef.h
- miniz_tinfl.c / miniz_tinfl.h

Build definition: MINIZ_NO_ZLIB_COMPATIBLE_NAMES.
